text:
Lina S: @channel New capacity note: launching H200 preemptible pools in three new AZs (eu-central-1a, ap-south-1b, us-east-2c) + updated preemptible burst policy. Rolling preview starts next week.
Tom B: Quick summary for folks who missed the planning sync?
Lina S: TL;DR: we need lower-cost transient capacity for batch inference. H200 preemptible pools give ~30% cost reduction vs H200 reserved for batch, lower than A100x preemptible historically but with better availability and predictability.
Tom B: Which regions and when?
Lina S: Regions: eu-central (zones a/b/c), ap-south (zone b), us-east-2 (zone c). Preview starts 2025-11-05 UTC, wide roll 2025-11-12.
EngInfra: Ops mechanics: preemptible label = `gpu=h200-preemptible`. New quota rules: preemptible pools capped at 40% of region reserved baseline to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
SRE-Oncall: Any new alerts?
Lina S: Yes: `dedicated.preemptible.h200.capacity_spike` and `dedicated.preemptible.h200.preemptions_high`. Both will surface in pager if spike >25% or preemptions/sec >5 sustained for 5m. OpsBot will summarize preemptions hourly during preview.
OpsBot: [automated] Preview reminders scheduled: 7d/2d/1d before preview and daily summaries during preview windows.
Nina P: Billing: preemptible pricing = reserved_price * 0.65. Note: billing reconciliation will appear as line-item `h200_preemptible_credit` for customers on auto-migrate.
Tom B: How do customers opt into preemptible for batch jobs?
Lina S: Via console toggle on a route or `redwoodctl create-job --gpu h200-preemptible --policy batch`. Auto-migrate option available for eligible jobs (see compatibility doc). Link: <https://go.redwood.ai/internal/dedicated/h200-preemptible-preview>.
EngInfra: quick helper to list preemptible instances:
```
redwoodctl instances list --filter "gpu=h200-preemptible" --fields id,customer_id,created_at
```
Tom B: Risk notes? Anything that could affect low-latency customers?
Lina S: Preemptible is strictly for batch/non-latency SLAs. We enforce route-level disallow for routes with latency SLA tags. If a customer tries to opt-in, console warns and requires explicit override.
SRE-Oncall: Schedule a canary run in staging for Friday 09:00 UTC and we'll monitor preemption churn.
Lina S: Action items: EngInfra publish runbooks + helper scripts (EOD Weds), SRE add alerts & dashboards (EOD Thurs), Billing publish pricing page and reconciliation notes (EOD Thurs), Support draft customer messaging (EOD Fri).
Tom B: Thanks all. Excited to see cheaper batch capacity land. :party_parrot:
